cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Not About Who Lost
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on rules, effort, or next steps instead of the result that embarrasses you.

mechanism: Copy confident early submission without understanding it, then protect the embarrassing quiz result by redirecting the partner toward submission practice.
confusable: Not generic sporting optimism: the misunderstood copied hand-in must cause the result A refuses to discuss.
comparison: A teammate accepts a practical rehearsal; alternative b disputes whose running behavior counts as expertise.
seedUse: Retains quiz preparation/result avoidance; introduces premature copied submission instead of merely adding assurance.
